top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises one complete, mature achievement: GLP-1 physiology (Drucker, Holst) carried through to the long-acting agonists (Knudsen) whose benefit is confirmed in large randomized trials. Knudsen's role in liraglutide and semaglutide is documented and undisputed, whereas Mojsov's priority against the Habener group, who are not credited, cannot be settled from the supplied record. P002 is a close second on the same science, and any award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no credited laureate is a documented collaborator, mentor or trainee of mine (disclosed ties are Paul Greengard and co-authorship with Thomas Perlmann, neither involving B043)
